minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  September 14, 2021

The Joint Powers Authority of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting
on Tuesday, September 14, 2021, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, Parking
Authority, and Joint Powers Authority at the hour of 2:00 p.m.
The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary/ Parking
Authority Secretary/Joint Powers Authority Secretary announced the presence of a
quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman/ Parking Authority Chairman/ Joint Powers
  Authority Chairman Butts, Council Members/Successor
  Agency Members/Housing Authority Members/ Parking
  Authority Members/ Joint Powers Authority Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and Faulk; and
  Absent:  None.
City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/ Parking Authority/ Joint Powers Authority
officials and personnel present were as follows:
  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Louis Atwell  Acting City Manager/Acting Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  David Esparza  Assistant City Manager
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

* Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, Parking Authority,
and Joint Powers Authority.
PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS. Mayor/Successor Agency
Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman/ Parking Authority Chairman/ Joint Powers
Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons present who wished to
address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/ Parking Authority/ Joint
Powers Authority on any item on the Agendas.
Cynthia Oliver, District 1 resident, spoke concerning the parking permit program.

JOINT POWERS AUTHORITY MINUTES.  It was moved by Joint Powers
Authority Member Morales, and seconded by Joint Powers Authority Member Faulk that
the Minutes for the Joint Powers Authority Meeting held on April 27, 2021, be approved.
The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes:  Joint Powers Authority Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Joint
  Powers Authority Chairman Butts; and
Noes:  None.

Joint Powers Authority Member Dotson left the dais at 2:50 p.m.

There being no further business to be presented, Chairman Butts adjourned the meeting in
memory of Sam Cunningham at the hour of 2:56 p.m.

Approved this 19th day of October, 2021.

  _________________________
  Aisha L. Thompson, Secretary

________________________
James Butts, Jr., Chairman
